description: Get the S3-compatible credentials of an app's file storage (R2), with the secret masked: accessKeyId, secretAccessKey (masked), endpoint, and bucketName. project_id takes the app's name. To set a value at the provider, run `telbase storage credentials <app> --get <VARIABLE>` in a pipe or an inline $(…) (R2_ENDPOINT, R2_ACCESS_KEY_ID, R2_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY, R2_BUCKET_NAME); never put the secret in a file or show it to the user. Returns 404 if the app has no storage bucket.

project_id.description: The app's name, or a project ID or slug.

name: get_storage_credentials
